item.title: Yosemite National Park ends its reservation system for 2026
item.description: Yosemite National Park announced Wednesday it will no longer use its reservation system in 2026.

item.title: Michelle Yeoh honored with star on Hollywood Walk of Fame: 'I'm so psyched'
item.description: Oscar-winning actress Michelle Yeoh has been honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

item.title: Layoffs loom days after SF school district agrees to $183 million deal to end teachers' strike
item.description: There were smiles and hugs from teachers and students who returned to school Wednesday after the citywide teachers' strike that ended in a $183 million deal with the school district. But looming over the historic deal is a cloud of potential layoffs in the near future.

item.title: Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee's office at City Hall broken into, SUV stolen, authorities say
item.description: The city-owned SUV that is used to shuttle around Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee was stolen this week after someone allegedly took the keys from the mayor's City Hall office, authorities said. "This says a lot about how bad crime in Oakland really is - when the mayor's office is broken into, her car is stolen."

item.title: 2 people found shot and killed inside Pleasanton home, authorities say
item.description: Police are investigating a double homicide in Pleasanton after they found two people shot and killed inside a home on Wednesday.

item.title: Experts share tips for staying safe while backcountry skiing
item.description: In wake of the deadly Castle Peak avalanche, experts share tips for staying safe while backcountry skiing.

item.title: Avalanches happen more often, and are deadlier across the country than we thought
item.description: Avalanches are common in the Sierra. The Tahoe region alone sees as many as 40 reported slides each winter. And according to the National Avalanche Center, 25 to 30 people die in avalanches across the United States every winter.

item.title: Parents of ski academy students among 8 dead; 1 still missing after avalanche near Donner Pass
item.description: ABC7 Eyewitness News has learned that some of the deceased victims are members of the Sugar Bowl Academy, a ski school in Placer County.
